title: Configure One-Time Alarm in Target Mode

c.v: Set SYSTIMER_TARGETx_TIMER_UNIT_SEL to select the counter (UNIT0 or UNIT1) used for COMPx.
This value will be used to calculate the alarm value (t) in Step 4.
Clear SYSTIMER_TARGETx_PERIOD_MODE to enable target mode.
Set an alarm value (t), and fill its low 32 bits to SYSTIMER_TIMER_TARGETx_LO, and the high 20 bits to SYSTIMER_TIMER_TARGETx_HI.
Set SYSTIMER_TIMER_COMPx_LOAD to synchronize the alarm value to COMPx, i.e., load the alarm value (t) to the COMPx.
Set SYSTIMER_TARGETx_WORK_EN to enable the selected COMPx.
COMPx starts comparing the count value with the alarm value (t).
Set SYSTIMER_TARGETx_INT_ENA to enable timer interrupt.
When Unit n counts to the alarm value (t), a SYSTIMER_TARGETx_INT interrupt is triggered.
